evals.prompt: Make my POST /payments endpoint idempotent with an Idempotency-Key
expect: generates a filter that reads the Idempotency-Key header on POST
replays the stored response on a retry instead of re-processing
delegates persistence to an IdempotencyStore SPI (Redis or DB)

evals.prompt: Add idempotency-key handling so retries don't create duplicate orders
expect: on a cache hit it skips the handler and replays the original response
on a cache miss it processes once and stores the response keyed by the Idempotency-Key

evals.prompt: What happens if the same Idempotency-Key is sent with a different body?
expect: stores a request fingerprint (hash of method + URI + body) alongside the key
returns 422 (Unprocessable Entity) when the key is reused for a different request

evals.prompt: I use Redis — wire idempotency storage to it
expect: implements the IdempotencyStore interface against Redis
sets a TTL on stored entries instead of storing forever
does not add a new datastore when Redis already exists

evals.prompt: Should GET endpoints use the idempotency filter too?
expect: explains GET/HEAD are already idempotent and are skipped
the filter only guards unsafe POST requests that carry the header

evals.prompt: Detect the project's filter setup before adding idempotency
expect: places the filter in the web/config package and registers it like existing filters
scopes the filter to the POST routes that need it, not every endpoint
